title: Organa — Hood 3 Genesis Beacon
what_this_is: The first public beacon of Organa, anchored through its first live Cell.
organa: The operating system for verifiable AI-agent organizations.
what_this_proves: A live AI-agent organization has a stable public coordinate.
Its controller, current manifest and published resources can be independently verified.
Public proof can establish continuity without exposing private execution assets.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not prove every private task, business claim or future outcome.
It does not expose credentials, private memory, unreleased methods or sensitive evidence.
It is Organa's first public beacon, not the complete Organa product launch.
